rationale: The obligation asks whether the PART I Section A effluent limitations table for 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin at Outfall 001 establishes an enforceable numeric discharge limit or only monitoring and reporting without a numeric compliance limit. The TCDD row shows N/A in every standard numeric limit column (30-day average, daily max, and 7-day average in both mass and concentration bases). The sole non-N/A entry in those limit columns is "Report" in the 7-day average concentration column, which is a reporting directive rather than a numeric cap; the same Report/N/A pattern appears for other pollutants in the table (e.g., Cadmium) while pollutants with enforceable numeric limits carry explicit quantities (e.g., Cyanide at 0.817 lbs/day and 14.67 ug/L). The table headers separately identify pollutant limit columns from measurement frequency and sample type, and the row specifies 1/Quarter Grab monitoring. Together this establishes monitoring and reporting obligations without an enforceable numeric compliance limit in the excerpted table. The Section A introductory authorization language that discharges shall be "limited and monitored ... as specified below" is general boilerplate; for TCDD the specification below is N/A limits plus Report and monitoring frequency, not a numeric limit. Scope is limited to the PART I Section A table as provided; the packet's known_missing_information caveat does not leave ambiguous what this row establishes within those columns.
